message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have real‑time internet access, so I can’t pull up today’s forecast for San Francisco. For the most accurate and up‑to‑date information you might want to check:

* Weather apps on your phone (Apple Weather, Google Assistant, etc.)  
* Websites such as [weather.com](https://www.weather.com), AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service  
* Local news stations’ websites or social media feeds  

Those will give you temperature, precipitation chances, wind speed, UV index, and other details right now.
